takeaways.text: Services revenue hit an all-time record of $23.1B, up 11% — now nearly a fifth of all sales — as Apple's installed base of active devices passed 2.2 billion, also an all-time high.
takeaways.title: Services set another record

takeaways.text: EPS rose 16% to an all-time high of $2.18, helped by margin expansion: gross margin widened to 45.9% from 43.0% a year ago, even as total sales grew just 2%.
takeaways.title: Record earnings per share

takeaways.text: This December quarter had 13 weeks versus 14 a year ago — so the 2% sales growth came on one fewer week; iPhone rose 6% to $69.7B while iPad fell 25% with no new models.
takeaways.title: A shorter quarter than last year

verdict: Apple's sales grew 2% to $119.6B as Services set an all-time record and iPhone rose 6% — and EPS hit an all-time high of $2.18, with $33.9B kept as profit.
